proposalRules.reviewerGate: check(p,data), record(p,data,review stamp), reverse(prior decision,current score,review stamp) in trusted Node, with real source/notes IDs and reviewed evidence commit SHA; no browser can mutate or auto-approve; nonzero directional revisions require github-approval.cjs API-confirmed distinct human approved review for current PR head SHA; use trusted fetchGitHubApproval, not unchecked reviewer text.

historicAudits.rule: Past no-change VC records remain immutable; this array records future scored revisions only. A future revision must reference the previous audit and evidence-bearing repository commit.
